name: Actions for GitHub
summary: GitHub Actions on your shelf, before you go looking
description:
Actions for GitHub watches the repositories you care about and keeps their GitHub Actions runs on Droppy's shelf.

Each repository gets a row: whether its default branch is green, the last dozen runs as a sparkline, how many of them passed, and how long ago. A run in flight rides beside the notch with its elapsed time, and a run that fails — or a branch that goes green again — says so in a HUD and then gets out of the way.

Add a GitHub token once and it is kept in your keychain, never in Droppy's preferences. Unchanged repositories are read conditionally, so watching five of them every two minutes costs a fraction of the hourly rate limit.
